foundation_name: Evidence-Bound Vertical AI Execution Foundation V1
responsibility: Design evidence-to-execution Vertical AI capacity with standardized certified connector selection and gated repository mutation

components.name: Execution Context
components.responsibility: Assemble a read-only execution context from planning runtime outputs, Platform Core, CIL, Repository Intelligence, and certified connector snapshots.

components.name: Execution Selector
components.responsibility: Select executable steps from validated execution plans using repository-first and reuse-before-create priority; never invents unauthorized writes.

components.name: Execution Dispatch
components.responsibility: Describe how selected steps would be dispatched to Agent Runtime through CIL runtime connectors; dispatch descriptors are design-only and not enacted in foundation.

components.name: Tool Selection
components.responsibility: Select Agent Runtime tools that may serve selected steps, using certified runtime contracts only; tools are references, never redefined here.

components.name: Consumer Connector Selection
components.responsibility: Standardize selection among certified consumer connectors (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, MCP) for reasoning-side participation; selection is reference-bound to master snapshots.

components.name: Execution Contract
components.responsibility: Declare the execution boundary contract: consumes Platform Core V1 / CIL V1 / RI / certified connectors only; forbids PC/CIL mutation and unapproved repository mutation.

components.name: Execution Validation
components.responsibility: Validate execution descriptors for evidence citations, connector certification, reuse precedence, and approval readiness before runtime handoff.

components.name: Execution Evidence
components.responsibility: Bind fingerprints and refs so every execution conclusion is preceded by planning and understanding evidence.

components.name: Execution Traceability
components.responsibility: Maintain evidence-to-execution traceability from planning outputs through selector, tools, connectors, dispatch, and validation.

components.name: Execution Reproducibility
components.responsibility: Ensure identical evidence and plan inputs yield identical execution design fingerprints across dual runs.

components.name: Execution Runtime Reference
components.responsibility: Reference the certified Agent Runtime and CIL runtime connector surfaces that future Execution Runtime will bind; reference-only, no mutation.

components.name: Approval Gate
components.responsibility: Require explicit human approval before any repository mutation that execution might later propose; foundation runs remain read-only.

components.name: Execution Boundary
components.responsibility: Codify immutable boundaries: no Platform Core mutation, no CIL mutation, certified-connector-only selection, repository mutation gated by human approval.
